country.evidence_quote: Welcome to Festiva, a family of boutique interval ownership resorts in some of the most sought-after destinations in the United States and Caribbean. Since forming in 2000, Festiva has become one of the most successful privately held vacation ownership companies in the country. In an industry where large, publicly held corporations have recently begun to dominate, Festiva has carved out a niche in a number of prime vacation markets.
